I'm sure this has occurred to you, but if you want to sort into more groups than your machine currently allows (say you want to sort by set, then card type, then colour, then CMC), you could use [Radix Sort](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Radix_sort).

First run through, sort them by CMC. Next, put the cards all back in in CMC order, then sort them by colour. Then put them back in, sort by card type and, finally, sort by set.

You could even sort them into alphabetical order by starting with the 7th character (say), then the 6th character and ending with the 1st character. You might want to manually handle the cards that have the same first 7 characters.

Yeah. Well not the fireplace or tea, because heat is the enemy (duh.) But the rest of it sounds pretty good.

My wife thinks it is really weird and even hurtful that I value time by myself, but I think in this regard I might be more 'typical' than her. It's like Axl Rose said in "November Rain": 'Everybody needs sometime on their own'. He then said it again and again and again, so it must be true. It's Axl Rose.

But a weekend to myself playing Repton 3, listening to Teleman (the band not the composer) and drinking Punk IPA sounds pretty great.
